description: Build a navigable map of an indexed source or domain with pages, documents, headings, and chunk ranges.

domain.description: Optional exact domain filter, for example physio-relax.de.

sourceId.description: Optional crawler source id, for example physio-relax-de.

top.description: Maximum chunks to inspect for the map. Defaults to 30.

userLocation.description: Optional approximate user location. Include only if the client or user has explicitly made it available; do not infer or guess it.

country.description: ISO country code when available, for example ES.

timezone.description: IANA timezone when available, for example Europe/Madrid.

name: get_source_map
title: Get Source Map
